This Calculator only calculates the accrual of long service leave on up to 52 weeks' unpaid leave.

results.title: Long Service Leave Calculator Australia - OneBookPlus
results.description:
# Long Service Leave Calculator Australia
## How long service leave works in Australia
### Long service leave entitlement by state (after 10 years)
| State / Territory | LSL after 10 years | Accrual / year | Can take from |
|-|-|-|-|
| ACT | 8.6667 weeks | 0.86667 wk | 7 years |

### How to calculate long service leave (the formula)
- **Accrued weeks:** years of continuous service × the state accrual rate (0.86667 wk/yr, or 1.3 wk/yr in SA & NT)

An employee with 10 years of continuous service on $1,500 per week (a 38-hour week at about $39.47/hr) accrues 10 × 0.86667 = **8.6667 weeks** of LSL, worth 8.6667 × $1,500 = **about $13,000**.

## How we calculate this
Accrued weeks are multiplied by your ordinary weekly pay to estimate the dollar value.

- [ACT Government, Long service leave](https://www.act.gov.au/business/employing-people/long-service-leave)
